sell-calc-box indicative status and refresh control

findings.trigger: Successful options refresh or Sell tab re-entry during pending sell order creation re-enabled sell-submit before the first POST completed.
findings.impact: A second review and confirmation could create a duplicate unpaid order.
findings.resolution: sellOrderPending spans awaited unchanged submitSellOrder; createSellOrder entry and confirmation callback reject reentry; options refresh preserves disabled while pending.
findings.verification: Final product diff inspected; targeted behavioral verification owned by primary agent.

assessment: Sell server rate is net RUB per coin; estimate multiplies amount*rate without deducting commission twice. Selected-coin fee_percent replaces global fee_label range. Missing market breakdown does not invalidate an otherwise valid rate and fee.

Receipt age is bounded to 60 seconds; endpoint has no server timestamp and UI does not claim market-source freshness or binding quote. Nonfinite, malformed, overflow and rounded-zero values suppress numeric estimate.

No-store requests have timeout/aborted-response and latest-generation guards. Failure clears snapshot and disables form submission. Expiry timer and visibility reentry clear stale form amount, fee and breakdown.

Select rebuilding preserves response-time choices, inserts empty placeholder for removed choices, and does not edit recipient fields. Empty payout-method guard prevents silently switching removed recipient route.

Review freezes fresh payout/fee/net rate and expiration, or explicitly discloses unavailable estimate. Existing shared review deadline handles expiration; Sell callback checks deadline and clock rollback.
Only agreed state/helper/form/review scopes changed. Shared review machinery, buy surface, submitSellOrder request payload and backend untouched.
Read-only production preflight passed with 56 live inputs and 4 unchanged services. Fourteen local scope/drift/atomic apply/reconcile/rollback checks passed.
